g.text: Publish to mail — owner-signed binding, and the binding's own states (incl. Provisioning)
Prepare (side-effect light: a render plus a uniqueness read)
-- NO account creation, NO key material
sign with the owner's wallet key
signer's own team record -- only the address
the team lives under may bind it. Binding key
REACTIVATES the record; a different team
success modal with the bound address
The bridge makes the address answer
mint DEK, wrap under operator KEK,
Binding states (chain record x bridge view)
active:false -> address leaves the refreshed set -> unknown(550); the record and the DEK survive,
so republishing restores Ready without re-provisioning.
The keystore split is the trust boundary: the on-chain binding
carries NO key material, and mailbox DEKs are minted and
custodied by the bridge -- an embers-held DEK would let embers
read third-party mail sent to the team, which the posting-only
